name: Markov Lab
desc: A word-level Markov chain lab: chain order, temperature and length sliders drive text generation from a built-in corpus, with the transition matrix shown as a heatmap.
controls: Chain-order, temperature and length sliders, three order presets, generate/retrain buttons, heatmap toggle; keys 1–3 set the order, G generates, R retrains
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
